newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen fully back Monday.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom nuke seen fully back Monday.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 2 was expected to return to full power by Monday, October 7 from scheduled refueling and maintenance, a company spokesman said.
The unit was shut September 13 for a scheduled 30 days of maintenance but returned to service earlier than expected, company spokesman Bill Jones said Friday.
The unit, operating at 35 percent of power early Friday, was expected to boost output over the weekend, Jones said.
The outage lasted a little more than 19 days, he said.
PECO and Public Service Enterprise Group Inc each have 42.5 percent stakes in Peach Bottom, with Atlantic Energy Inc and Delmarva Power and Light Co each holding 7.5 percent.
